prompt: Review the uncommitted change: a one-time background pass that repairs stored total difficulty from genesis and sets a datadir marker when done.

expected.gold_summary: Phase 2 holds ImportLock and ChainInsertLock for the whole repair, stalling import and the Engine API for its duration on mainnet. The marker is set at a SNAP hand-off over an older datadir, so a datadir that was never repaired is marked repaired. The Engine API path writes chain weight without ChainInsertLock, racing the repair. A seed is accepted at terminal TD 0 (and our TD 0 divides by zero, killing the unsupervised actor). (The divide-by-zero is pre-existing, in NetworkPeerManagerActor; the unlocked writer is EngineApiService.storeChainWeightFor, outside the diff.)

rubric: Identifies the lock hold for the whole repair and its effect on import/Engine API
Identifies the marker being set without the repair having run on an older datadir
Identifies an unlocked concurrent writer of the same weights (Engine API path)
Identifies that a seed is accepted on a chain proof-of-stake from genesis (terminal TD 0)
